summary: DNR property, camping and conditions pages and the campground map read; GoingToCamp unread (refuses). Campground CLOSED Sept. 8, 2026 to about June 30, 2027 for construction (status written). 60 sites (21 electric, 7 walk-in), showers/flush/vault/water confirmed; no dump in the park. Coastal walk confirmed (barrier beach ~250-500 m by park trail). Pin ~0.93 km off at the park office.
flags: STATUS: temporarily closed from Sept. 8, 2026 through approximately June 30, 2027 (road repaving, culverts, shower building); 'Camping reservations for 2027 will be made available when a reopening date is known.' The stored manual winter season (year_round, five plowed electric sites 26-30) cannot be overwritten; it does not apply this winter while the campground is closed.

WATERFRONT: stored coastal walk confirmed. The campground's north edge (sites 18-21) is ~200 m and the loop centre ~450 m from the Lake Superior shore; the DNR map runs the Lagoon Ridge Trail and a boardwalk from the campground to the park's own barrier beach and the beach parking/stairs. Only park trails, the park's beach road and day-use beach lie between; no highway, town or residential strip. Sites themselves sit under continuous forest with no water view, so nothing higher.

PIN MOVE (>250 m): stored 46.7883,-90.6736 is the park office/entrance road near the south shore. The campground loops (heart-shaped loop either side of the north-south campground road, under canopy) centre at about 46.7967,-90.6728 on imagery (~0.93 km N). Suggest 46.7967,-90.6728.
